_comment: Device profiler overhead CI golden (Blackhole, bh_p150_perf). ARMED: real_time values are real measurements captured on bh_p150_perf CI silicon (ENABLE_TRACY=ON, WITHOUT TT_METAL_PROFILER_ACCUMULATE, min aggregate, single-run centers). The runtime_perf_profiler_overhead CI job runs compare_profiler_overhead_ci.py WITHOUT --ignore-times, so metrics with a numeric real_time are gated at +/-tolerance (default 25%). BM_profiler_read (the ReadMeshDeviceProfilerResults L1->DRAM writeout; dominant ~5.1-5.9ms, cv<5%) is gated. BM_profiled_dispatch (profiler-enabled EnqueueMeshWorkload+Finish, ~13-14us) is left record-only (real_time=null -> tracked, not gated): although it is stable here (cv 2-3%), it is very noisy on Wormhole (cv 18-28%), so it is kept ungated on both SKUs for parity and to avoid flaky gates. Reference bh_p150_perf dispatch min (ns): common ~13143, worst ~13988.
